headline: Local Kitchen Stoves Across State Simultaneously Begin Playing Festive Music In Anticipation Of 2027 Subsidy
body: Kitchen appliances across the region have reportedly synchronized their burners to broadcast a brass-heavy rendition of the state anthem, a phenomenon technicians attribute to internal calendars prematurely celebrating the upcoming LPG reimbursement. Experts advise homeowners to simply dance along, as the phenomenon is expected to dissipate once the first subsidized cylinder is connected in early 2027.
caption: Your gas stove might start singing before you even light it. The future of cooking is surprisingly musical. #Pongal2027 #LPG #KitchenSymphony #TamilNadu (satire)
igHook: Does your kitchen appliance have a hidden musical talent too?
imagePrompt: A close-up view of a standard stainless steel gas stovetop in a bright, modern Indian kitchen, with a blurry background of a countertop featuring various stainless steel kitchen utensils.

sourceHeadline.title: Tamil Nadu government to reimburse cost of three LPG cylinders annually from Pongal 2027: CM Vijay
